title: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR SELF-RELIANT COOPERATIVES ACT, 1999
full_text: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR SELF-RELIANT COOPERATIVES ACT, 1999 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 199910 Act Number: 10 Enactment Date: 1999-05-11 Act Year: 1999 Short Title: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR SELF-RELIANT COOPERATIVES ACT, 1999 Long Title: An Act to provide for the formation and transformation of Cooperatives as self-reliant, self-help, mutual-aid, autonomous, voluntary, democratic, business enterprises, owned, managed and controlled by members for their economic and social betterment, through the financially gainful provision of core services which fulfil a common need felt by them and for the matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
